title: New home page structure
question: Three ways to build the new technext.asia home page in today's colours and fonts, futuristic and animated, BIR first. Pick one (or steer / re-roll).

options.label: Spreadsheet to Odoo
options.thesis: The page is one long transformation: a messy BIR spreadsheet re-assembles into Odoo records and BIR reports as you scroll.
options.viewport: Split hero: left a glitching Excel 2307/SLSP sheet with red error cells; right a glass Odoo console where rows snap in and '2307 generated · SLSP ready · e-invoice sent' lights up. Headline 'BIR compliance, handled in your Odoo.' Primary: Book a discovery call.
options.risk: Strong for finance heads; needs care so the 'mess' never reads as mocking the visitor.

options.label: BIR readiness check
options.thesis: The hero is a 4-question BIR check; the page answers 'am I covered, and what do I need?' before it sells anything.
options.viewport: Left: four tap-to-answer questions (taxpayer size, sell online?, on CAS/CBA?, branches). Right: a glass result panel that updates live: 'Covered by 31 Dec 2026', the steps you need (PTI, EIS certification, books in ORUS) and a deadline countdown. Primary: Book a discovery call with your answers attached.
options.risk: The answers must stay general guidance with 'confirm with your accountant', never tax advice.

regions.label: what Odoo produces: 2307, SLSP, SAWT, QAP, 2550Q

options.label: Advisers first
options.thesis: Lead with the people: the experts who will set up your BIR books, their skills and the companies they've worked on.
options.viewport: A fanned stack of glass adviser cards (placeholders until real data) with name, role, BIR/Odoo skills and companies worked on; the front card flips on hover. Headline 'Your BIR and Odoo advisers, in-house.' Primary: Book a discovery call.
options.risk: Until real names and photos arrive, the hero runs on placeholders, so it cannot go live until you send them.
